title: fix(lint, service-automation): the date-text value-envelope refusal names the shared-steps rewrite
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D62xGLMbyWJaMEVnAMEjTK1)_
Fixes #34694
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:写带日期字段公式的自动化流程作者,在流程本身有记录触发器、又被另一个流程调用时,仍会收到拒绝,但提示里多了一句改写方法:把共用步骤挪进一个没有自己触发器的子流程。
- 为什么做:按维护者裁决「继续拒绝+改写提示」,被拒绝的范围不变,只让作者知道怎么改。
- 出错会怎样:只多了一句提示文字,可以直接撤回;拒绝与否不受影响。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Ruling 7023700548 (maintainer 「继续拒绝+改写提示」, which supersedes 7023408378) decides the behaviour. A flow with its own record trigger or time-relative sweep stays refused at both doors when its value envelope runs a typed date-text check on a field. Example: `timestamp(record.borrow_date)` over a `date` field. This holds even when another flow also starts it through a `subflow` or `map` node, because its own trigger hands it a row of the typed object on every run that trigger starts. The refused set does not change (PR 34654 seat ruling S1(i) stands).

- **The refusal names the rewrite.** At both doors, the typed date-text verdict on a flow value envelope gets one more sentence, after the verdict's own `date(...)` / `addDays` fix. The verdict codes are `date-text-call-value-run-may-fail` and `date-text-arithmetic-value-run-may-fail`. The sentence says: move the shared steps into a child flow with no trigger of its own, which is judged untyped because its `record` is whatever each caller hands it, and start that child from both flows. The two doors are:
  - `@objectstack/lint` `validate-expressions.ts` `checkDeclaredValue`. This covers `os validate` / `os build` and the runtime publish gate, which runs the same pass.
  - `@objectstack/service-automation` `flow-registration-checks.ts`. This covers `registerFlow` and the `os migrate meta --stored` TODO reason, which lists the same site detail.
  
  Every other value-envelope refusal reads as before.
- **Two docblocks corrected.** Both said a flow a parent's `subflow` / `map` starts is judged untyped. Now they say this holds only for a flow with no trigger of its own, and that a record-triggered or sweep flow stays typed when a parent also starts it. The docblocks are `validate-expressions.ts` (the `valueEnvelopeFieldTypes` note, was ~3341) and `flow-registration-checks.ts` (the `runBindsTypedRow` note, was ~790).
- **Not catalogued or translated.** The sentence is not catalogued or translated anywhere. The verdict text is English composed at each door, and no locale bundle carries `VALUE_ENVELOPE_REFUSAL` or the verdict codes (`git grep` over translations and locales: 0 hits). `@objectstack/lint` is not a dependency of `service-automation`, so each door spells the sentence once, and each door's test pins it.

## Evals

None. The change is to a refusal's wording only.

## Verification

All readings were taken on head `4c182ef9`. That commit is the patch round on L1-a's pre-read. The typed verdict also reaches a time-relative sweep, so at both doors the sentence now reads "This flow has its own record trigger or time-relative sweep, which hands it a row of that object on every run it starts, ...". The text is identical at both doors, and each door gained one sweep pin.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run -t 'parent also starts' src/validate-expressions.test.ts`. Expect 2 passed: the `subflow` and `map` parents, each with the trigger-less CONTROL.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- New pins, at both doors, use the round-1 probe shape. The child is record-triggered on `library_loan` (`borrow_date: date`), with `update_record` `fields.due_date = timestamp(record.borrow_date)`. The parent is record-triggered on `event` (`borrow_date: datetime`) and starts the child through `subflow`, and through `map` with `itemObject: event`. The child stays refused at the slot, and the message carries both the `addDays` fix and the rewrite clause. CONTROL: the same child with no trigger of its own is not refused. At the engine it registers, and the stored pass lists nothing.
- Sweep pins, one per door. A time-relative flow sweeping `library_loan` with the measured envelope is refused, and its message contains "This flow has its own record trigger or time-relative sweep, which hands it a row".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 221 passed (221), Tests 9314 passed (9314).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: Test Files 289 passed (289), Tests 4198 passed (4198).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint --filter @objectstack/service-automation typecheck`: OK, with the test layer OK for both packages. The whole chain ran under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation, at `180683a7`, once per door, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The appended `${rewrite}` was removed, and the anchor went 1 -> 0 on disk. lint: Tests 2 failed. service-automation: Tests 2 failed (`expected 'Flow 'loan_due_child' has 1 invalid…' to contain 'move them into a child flow with no t…'`). Both restores were verified: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The first engine attempt was refused by the tool before running (the replacement text already occurred in the anchor), so it measured nothing and was rerun with a distinct replacement.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 69 families on `4c182ef9`, all run locally with their exit codes recorded. `--ran` reconciliation: 67 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun. The two NOT MEASURED families both exited 3, a prerequisite this checkout lacks:
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: a shallow clone cannot reach its pinned fixture commit.
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: needs a full `pnpm build`.

CI runs both. `overlap-check --branch=claude/area-a4W-34694` against origin/main `03865ae9`: VERDICT clean exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Round 1 stopped for a decision. The arm-A order of round 2 was paused before any code once the seat's review showed the engine cannot see a parent at registration. This round builds ruling 7023700548 only. Out of scope by the ruling: arm A's riders, the `engine.ts` / `plugin.ts` docblocks, and the three ADR-0087 semantic entries. Those entries' "refuse the same set" text stays true, because the refused set does not change.
- The sentence is spelled twice, once at each door, because the packages share no dependency for it. A drift between the two would show as one door's pin going red, not as silence.
